translation: The Spiritual Pivot Classic says: The branch of the foot Lesser Yin (Kidney) reaches the popliteal fossa, then branches to the Greater Yang and joins it, ascends to the kidney, at the fourteenth vertebra emerges and belongs to the Belt Vessel. Master Yang said: The Belt Vessel binds and restrains all the vessels, keeping them from running recklessly, just as a person's belt hangs down in front; hence its name. In women, lochia (elou) descends along the Belt Vessel, and so it is called vaginal discharge (daixia).
